retrievalProfile.description: A four-quadrant grid of duotone portraits featuring high-contrast halftone textures, torn paper borders, and hand-scribbled name tags.
excludeWhen: a clean minimalist layout is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A 2x2 grid of square portraits, each set against a different vibrant solid color background with a rough, torn-paper perimeter. The portraits are rendered in a dark, grainy halftone style that interacts with the background color. Each panel includes a hand-drawn, messy circle containing a name in casual handwriting.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast dark subjects against bright saturated backgrounds
Rough, organic torn-paper edges against a clean white border
Informal hand-drawn annotations overlaying structured photography
coreInvariants: Halftone dot pattern texture across all portraits
Torn paper edge effect on the internal square boundaries
Hand-drawn circular scribbles for name tags

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four equal-sized squares centered in the frame, each containing a medium close-up portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-center bold lowercase title and the bottom-center script subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern starting from the top-left quadrant, moving through the grid, and ending at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Wide white margins surrounding the central 2x2 grid.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for typography and portrait shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime green, magenta, cyan, and golden yellow for the quadrant backgrounds
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation backgrounds with high-contrast black halftone overlays.
paletteRestrictions: Four distinct primary/secondary hues for the grid

letterConstructionRules: Top title: Ultra-bold, lowercase, tight kerning with a grainy ink-bleed texture.
Bottom title: Slanted, brush-like script with varying stroke weights.
Name tags: Raw, hand-drawn marker style with irregular heights.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' in top title has a closed counter and heavy weight.
Script 'F' and 'L' have elongated, expressive tails.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy lowercase sans-serif for impact paired with a light, rhythmic script for narrative feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, lowercase, wide-set display feel.
Approximates the casual, slanted subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid of four square portraits. Each portrait should be a black halftone duotone over a solid color background (Lime, Magenta, Cyan, Yellow). Apply a torn-paper edge effect to each square. Place the grid on a white textured paper background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, lowercase black sans-serif title at the top. Add a black script subtitle at the bottom. Overlay hand-drawn marker circles and names in the top-left corner of each quadrant.

verificationChecks: Are there four distinct background colors?
Do the portraits have a visible halftone dot texture?
Are the edges of the color squares rough and torn?
Is the top text lowercase and ultra-bold?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific band name or song title
Do not use the specific faces from the image
Do not use the specific 'Cactus Ropes' logo on the hat

mustAchieve: Consistent torn-paper aesthetic across all panels

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 2x2 grid is perfectly centered.
Ensure the halftone effect doesn't obscure facial features.
Verify the 'torn' edges look organic and not repetitive.
Confirm the hand-drawn circles look like real marker ink.
recipe.reuseFormula: 2x2 Duotone Grid + Halftone Portraits + Torn Edges + Hand-Drawn Annotations
